tasks.description: Ingest raw records from the upstream source into a staging area. This is the first stage and has no prerequisites. The ingested records should be stored in a temporary location for further processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given raw records from the upstream source, when ingested into the staging area, then the records are stored in a temporary location.

tasks.description: Validate the ingested records against the schema, rejecting malformed rows. Validation runs only on the output of the ingest stage and depends on it. The validation should check for data types, formats, and required fields.
acceptance_criteria: Given ingested records, when validated against the schema, then malformed rows are rejected and valid rows are passed to the next stage.

tasks.description: Transform the validated records into the canonical internal format. Transformation operates solely on the validated output and depends on the validate stage. The transformation should handle data type conversions, formatting, and data normalization.
acceptance_criteria: Given validated records, when transformed into the canonical internal format, then the records are in the expected format.

tasks.description: Deduplicate the transformed records, removing exact and near-duplicate entries. Deduplication runs on the transformed output and depends on the transform stage. The deduplication should use a suitable algorithm to identify duplicates.
acceptance_criteria: Given transformed records, when deduplicated, then exact and near-duplicate entries are removed.

tasks.description: Load the deduplicated records into the target warehouse. Loading consumes the deduplicated output and depends on the deduplicate stage. The loading should handle data insertion, updates, and error handling.
acceptance_criteria: Given deduplicated records, when loaded into the target warehouse, then the records are successfully inserted or updated.

tasks.description: Notify downstream consumers that fresh data is available. Notification fires only after a successful load and depends on the load stage. The notification should be sent to the designated recipients or systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful load, when notification is sent, then downstream consumers are informed that fresh data is available.
